summary: Cascading threshold classifier invoked by SoundEventDispatcher (0x00411E90). When both a2 and a4 are zero, widens integer a3 to double and selects one of 17 bucket indices (1..17) through a chain of double comparisons against read-only threshold constants; final buckets 14..17 are decided by integer comparisons a3 >= 75, a3 >= 110 and a3 >= 999. Writes the bucket index to a1+8 and the result of sub_414180(0) to a1+12, returning 1. When the active-guard fails (a2 or a4 non-zero) the function does not touch a1 and returns -1.

operations.description: Active guard: when a2 != 0 or a4 != 0 the classifier is skipped; result stays -1 and neither a1+8 nor a1+12 is written.
Widen integer a3 to double v5 for the subsequent float threshold comparisons.

Cascading double-threshold chain over v5 selects bucket index v6 in 1..17. The thresholds are read from the 13 read-only double globals dbl_59E420, dbl_59E788, dbl_59E790, dbl_59E798, dbl_59E7A0, dbl_59E7A8, dbl_59E7B0, dbl_59E7B8, dbl_59E7C0, dbl_59E7C8, dbl_59E7D0, dbl_59E7D8, dbl_59E7E0. After the last double threshold, the remaining buckets 14..17 are chosen by integer checks on a3: a3 >= 75, a3 >= 110, and a3 >= 999.
Write the selected bucket index v6 to *(a1 + 8) (this+0x8).
Call sub_414180 with argument 0 and store its returned value at *(a1 + 12) (this+0xC).
Return 1 on successful classification; otherwise the pre-set result -1 is returned.
